$note: Release thresholds, fixed before any run is scored (issue #1/#7). A capability row's status is derived mechanically from receipts by scripts/parity-matrix.mjs; nothing here may be edited to make a run pass.

status_rules.demonstrated: successes == repeats_required on the Codewhale surface AND (no Codex column OR Codex successes <= Codewhale successes)
status_rules.partial: 1 <= successes < repeats_required, or demonstrated on Codewhale but Codex column shows more successes
status_rules.missing: successes == 0 with the tool present, or the tool/backend reports unsupported
status_rules.untested: no receipts for the surface/platform, or every attempt was skipped for a missing precondition (e.g. optional_a11y with no accessible app)

release_gates.parity_claim_requires: every task tagged issue 2 or 3 is 'demonstrated' AND a Codex column exists for the same tasks on the same OS AND every 'untested' row is listed verbatim in docs/LIMITATIONS.md
release_gates.linux_x11_release_requires: all non-optional tasks 'demonstrated' on linux-x11; optional_a11y tasks may be 'untested' but must be listed
release_gates.macos_release_requires: a linux-style run on macOS 14+ with both Retina and non-Retina displays recorded; until such receipts exist the README must not claim macOS parity
release_gates.max_pointer_interference_local: hardware pointer displacement during a task is reported, not gated, on the shared-desktop route; the isolated-desktop route (--isolated) must report 0 px displacement and unchanged active window on the host display

codex_baseline.how: Fill parity/results/codex-<os>-<date>.json by hand from a Codex CLI session driving the same fixtures with the same goals (see docs/PARITY.md). Absent file => Codex column is 'untested' and no parity claim may be published.
